# LuminaSky Glass Services

> Glass and window repair specialists serving the Greater Toronto Area. We repair sealed units, foggy glass, window hardware, front door glass, patio doors, skylights, and commercial glass. Family-owned since 2024.

## Company Info
- Name: LuminaSky Glass Services
- Location: Thornhill, Ontario, Canada
- Phone: 437-344-8490
- Email: service@luminasky.com
- Website: https://www.luminasky.com
- Hours: Open 24/7
- Service type: Mobile service (we come to you)

## Core Services
- [Foggy Glass Repair](https://www.luminasky.com/foggy-windows): Sealed unit replacement for condensation between panes
- [Front Door Glass](https://www.luminasky.com/front-door-glass): Decorative, frosted, or clear glass inserts
- [Window Crank Repair](https://www.luminasky.com/cranks): Casement and awning window hardware repair
- [Patio Door Repair](https://www.luminasky.com/patio-door-repair): Rollers, tracks, locks, and glass replacement
- [Skylight Repair](https://www.luminasky.com/skylights): Leak repair and glass replacement
- [Commercial Glass](https://www.luminasky.com/commercial-glass-repair): Storefronts, office partitions, safety glass
- [Emergency Glass Repair](https://www.luminasky.com/emergency-glass-repair): Board-up and same-day glass replacement
- [Window Screens](https://www.luminasky.com/window-screens): Custom screen building and re-screening
- [Screen and Storm Doors](https://www.luminasky.com/screen-storm-doors): Installation and repair

## Service Area
Toronto, North York, Scarborough, Etobicoke, Markham, Vaughan, Richmond Hill, Thornhill, Mississauga, Brampton, Oakville, Burlington, Aurora, Newmarket, Woodbridge, Maple, Ajax, Barrie, Bradford, Caledon, Clarington, East Gwillimbury, Georgina, Halton Hills, Hamilton, Innisfil, King City, Milton, Orangeville, Oshawa, Pickering, Stouffville, Uxbridge, Whitby

## How It Works
1. Call or text 437-344-8490 for a $30 site visit (credited toward repair)
2. Technician measures and provides a written quote on the spot
3. Glass is custom-made, then installed on a scheduled return visit
4. Hardware repairs are typically completed same-day on the first visit

## Warranty
- 5-year seal warranty on glass
- 2-year workmanship warranty on glass installation
- 1-year warranty on hardware repairs

## About
Founded by Dan in 2024. LuminaSky focuses on repairing existing windows rather than replacing them, saving homeowners money. 60+ 5-star Google reviews.
